title: Investigate duplicate billing webhooks before blaming provider retries
raw_problem: Some customers were charged twice after billing webhooks retried during a provider incident. The first proposal is to disable retries. Should we disable provider retries or verify idempotency handling first?
recommended_next_action: Audit webhook event ids against charge creation ids, add an idempotency assertion in a replay test, and only change retry settings after proving duplicate handling is safe.
open_questions: Were duplicate events processed with the same provider event id?
Does the handler persist idempotency before or after creating the charge?
Can replaying the same event twice create more than one internal charge?
